title: Chapter 1233
text:
"The body has been reborn, and the soul is still strong … This should be an ability similar to possession?"

Looking at Gaud's black cocoon, Han Xiaoxin was surprised, and his brain started working quickly.

According to the introduction of [Esper Ability — Rebirth], its effect was similar to a Psychic's Mind Host, and it was also similar to Sorokin's ability to change identities. Judging from the various abnormalities in Gaud's interface, this was most likely a bigshot who had changed his identity.

The specific mechanism of this ability was still unclear. It should be a change of body, and the soul would be inherited. Then, based on the strength of the other party's Intelligence and Mystery attributes, Han Xiaoxin could determine that the other party should have been a Beyond Grade A before he was reborn.

Then, here came the problem. [Esper Ability — Rebirth] did not seem to have any combat strength, its uses were limited, and its growth rate was low. It should not be able to reach Beyond Grade A.

Either the other party did not have this ability and received the help of another Super who had [Esper Ability — Rebirth] to complete the rebirth. Or, the other party had become a Beyond Grade A with [Esper Ability — Rebirth].

The former was impossible to speculate, but if it was the latter, among the people Han Xiao knew, there seemed to be only one person who had this ability …

EsGod!

"Could it be this b * stard? His body was locked in the Spacetime Amber, but his soul escaped? "

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. As a researcher, he was used to making bold assumptions.

First of all, the probability of EsGod breaking out of the Spacetime Amber was not high, so he should have left a backup plan before he was captured.

The possibility of this was not low. EsGod was so reckless, and there were enemies everywhere. He would most likely have left a backup plan in advance. Furthermore, he had devoured so many strange Esper Abilities, so the probability of him having a soul reincarnation ability was not low. Maybe this was why he was so confident, changing his identity after losing his main identity.

However, the method of reincarnation for [Esper Ability — Rebirth] was different. Using Sorokin as an example, no matter how the smirking boy changed his identity, his ability would not change. The foundation was his soul. The foundation of the ability to absorb Esper Ability was the genetic chain of the physical body. EsGod's body was trapped in the Spacetime Amber. If Gaud was really EsGod, then he would have changed his body, and his ability would also change accordingly. The ability to absorb Esper Ability would be gone, and it would become a single ability, [Energy Control].

"Could it be that Gaud is a container that EsGod secretly prepared for himself … Hmm, I remember that EsGod has been working hard on synthesizing Super High Risk Esper Abilities and controlling energy. Maybe this is the result of his many years of hard work. This b * stard might have really succeeded, fusing a bunch of Esper Abilities and creating a crazy ability. Through some unknown means, he implanted it into Gaud's body …"

Han Xiao pondered.

Gaud did not appear out of thin air. He had a complete life history. Since the dynasty was willing to nurture him, they must have confirmed his family background.

If this was EsGod's doing, then he must have started planning a long time ago. He did not know what method he used to create a clean alias.

Following this hypothesis, EsGod joining the three Universal Civilizations after reincarnating was probably not something as flashy as' joining just because he couldn't beat them 'but a long-term plan.

The real situation might be like this:

For the sake of his primitive accumulation, EsGod committed countless sins and became enemies with the world. In the end, he synthesized a Super High Risk Esper Ability with unlimited potential. However, the alias' EsGod 'was already notorious. Even if he obtained the ability, he would never be at peace. Furthermore, the side effect of swallowing Esper Abilities without restraint was that his genetic chain was overloaded. He might have planned to abandon this alias a long time ago!

Therefore, EsGod placed the synthesized Super High Risk Esper Ability in a 'container', waiting for the day to use Esper Ability — Rebirth. He would transfer his soul into the container and obtain a new life. With the results of his previous alias, he would join the three Universal Civilizations and be nurtured by the advanced civilizations.

Han Xiao pondered. "EsGod is definitely capable of doing such a thing. He doesn't care whether he's a wanted criminal or a hitman of a civilization. The division of factions is just a means to him to obtain benefits. He only has one goal from the beginning, which is to reach a higher realm …"

The more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was possible. EsGod had been a wanted criminal for so many years, so he definitely knew how to be cunning. This plan should only be one of EsGod's plans.

However, all of these deductions were based on the idea that 'Gaud is EsGod'. In fact, the (Esper Ability — Rebirth) talent alone could not perfectly prove this theory. What Han Xiao was doing now was just making a hypothesis and deducing the cause from the effect.

Although he felt that the possibility of Gaud being EsGod was not low, he did not dare believe in his own imagination. He might really be someone else, and that would be a mistake.

"Bold hypothesis, careful verification … It's a pity that bold explorers are useless against people. Otherwise, there would be new clues."

Han Xiao shook his head.

No matter who the other party was, in terms of reincarnation alone, Gaud probably did it flawlessly and did not leave any clues. He thought that no one would be able to discover it, which is why he acted so relaxed in front of me.

Thankfully, my level is higher than his, so I can see all of his abilities. Maybe I'm the only one who discovered Gaud's secret …

Han Xiao did not leave. He sat at the side and waited silently, calculating in his mind.

After waiting for a while, the black cocoons in the room shattered one after another. The dynasty elites completed their baptism one after another and felt refreshed. Seeing that Han Xiao was actually accompanying them here, they could not help but feel flattered.

Gaud's baptism process was the longest, and he was the last one to break out of the cocoon.

"How do you feel?" Han Xiao acted as usual, and his tone was friendly.

"The effect is not bad." Gaud glanced at Han Xiao. "When I was evolving, I felt someone poke me with a needle. Was that you?"

"Haha, don't mind it. That's a probe used to detect if the evolution process is smooth. You're a direct descendant of the dynasty, so of course I have to care about you. After all, evolution is full of randomness, and there are risks. I don't want anything to happen to you." Han Xiao smiled and found an excuse.

Hearing this, Gaud could not take it seriously. He calmly said, "Thank you for your concern. I still have to make a trip to Planet Finn, so I won't disturb you any longer."

Seeing that Gaud had expressed his intention to leave, Han Xiao did not stop him. He smiled and said, "Alright, I won't keep you any longer. Let's meet in the association."

Then, Han Xiao turned around and left the hall, disappearing from everyone's sight very quickly.

Gaud's eyes sparkled. He followed the receptionist back to the dock and returned to the fleet with the dynasty elites.

The dynasty fleet very quickly left the spaceport orbit and shot into space, quickly splitting into two. One fleet returned with the dynasty elites, and the other fleet carried Gaud to Planet Finn deep in the Flickering World.

In the spaceship, Gaud looked at the Black Star Palace that was gradually disappearing from the porthole, and the corners of his lips curled up.

"Black Star, oh Black Star, I told you, we'll meet again sooner or later, but you didn't expect that when I stood in front of you again, you wouldn't recognize me and even want to be friends with me … heh."

Seeing how Black Star was being kept in the dark, Gaud could not help but laugh in his mind.

The enemy was in the light, and he was in the dark. It was a different kind of thrill to be in front of Black Star.

When he was evolving earlier, he used his ability to try to analyze the evolution energy. With the advantage of his ability, he already had some ideas.

"As expected of a terrifying ability in theory. As long as I have time, there's a sixty percent chance that I'll be able to analyze the theory. Then, I'll be able to report back to the dynasty, and my status in the dynasty will rise. When the upper echelons see how useful I am in this aspect, there's a higher chance that they'll agree to my request to be transferred to the dynasty's Academy of Science. This way, I'll be able to get close to the dynasty's research results on that data …"

Gaud outlined his plan in his mind, and a playful smile appeared on his face.

…

On the other side, Han Xiao looked at the dynasty fleet from his office with sparkling eyes.

"I didn't alert him. Gaud probably doesn't know that I've seen through his secret. The most important mission now is to confirm this guy's background. He's a hidden danger …"

Han Xiao frowned.

The current situation was not good for him. Gaud was a direct member of the dynasty, and this identity was his protective talisman. He could not act recklessly.

The most important thing now was to obtain evidence to prove that there was something fishy about Gaud. Only then would he have a good reason to attack.

Otherwise, if he directly attacked and killed the new direct Beyond Grade A that the dynasty had high hopes for, the dynasty's reaction would be obvious.

The dynasty had to give an explanation to all direct members, so they would not tolerate or compromise. If he did not give in, the worst-case scenario would be falling out with the dynasty instantly, which would destroy all his plans so far. Even if he was very useful to the dynasty now, there was no room for negotiation when it came to matters of this nature. Even if the dynasty did not want him as an ally, the dynasty would not hesitate.

As long as there was no evidence, any explanation for this kind of behavior would be useless and empty words without any basis.

If he really wanted to attack without any evidence, he had to do it secretly and eliminate all clues. There could not be any witnesses, no news could be leaked, and no suspects could be left behind. He could not fail …

"This is too risky. If there's even the slightest mistake, there'll be endless trouble."

Han Xiao shook his head.

Giving up the interests and connections that he had built for so long for Gaud was undoubtedly a huge loss. Unless he had no other choice, he would definitely not do this.

There was a better route now, and Han Xiao did not want to take this risk.

"If EsGod is really Gaud, then there's definitely something wrong with the body he left in the Spacetime Amber … Looks like I have to apply to the dynasty and visit EsGod."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

Gaud still had to stay in the Flickering World for a while, so it would be best if he discovered the problem before he returned. Otherwise, it would be difficult to do anything when Gaud returned to the dynasty.

Ding!

While he was deep in thought, there was a sudden movement on the interface.

You have triggered the hidden mission (Gaud's Secret)!

Mission Introduction: Gaud is a new direct Beyond Grade A of the Red Empire. During your contact with him, you coincidentally discovered his abnormality. Maybe there's some shocking secret behind this.

Mission Requirements: Uncover Gaud's Secret

Reward: x1 Character Summon Card. Randomly draw one of his abilities.

Han Xiao regained his senses and looked at the interface.

"Triggered a hidden mission … Is it because I saw his abilities? The trigger condition is a little high. Only those whose level is higher than Gaud can see all his abilities. Other than me, I'm afraid no one else can trigger this mission. "
